Vissel Kobe vs Ulsan: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of a key group stage match in the AFC Champions League Elite, where Japan's Vissel Kobe hosts South Korea's Ulsan at Misaki Park Stadium. This is a showdown between two contenders for the top spot in the group, promising a tense and spectacular encounter.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 10:00 UTC (13:00 MSK) Stadium: Misaki Park Stadium, Kobe Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Vissel Kobe vs Ulsan: Match Preview

Both teams have had a successful start to the tournament, however, Ulsan currently leads the group standings with a one-point advantage over Vissel Kobe after three rounds. The Japanese club has experienced a dip in form recently, going winless in their last four games across all competitions. In their last J.League fixture, Vissel Kobe squandered a 2-0 lead, drawing 2-2 with Albirex Niigata. In contrast, Ulsan was on a three-match unbeaten streak before a recent 3-1 loss to Anyang. The head-to-head history consists of just two matches, with each team winning on the road.

Team Form and Analysis

Vissel Kobe

Despite their current slump, Vissel Kobe remains a formidable force, especially at home. The team is unbeaten in their last seven home matches, winning five and keeping six clean sheets. The Japanese side boasts the most potent attack in the Champions League, having scored 7 goals in three games. However, their defense is a concern, having conceded six goals in their last two games. In attack, all eyes will be on veteran forward Yuya Osako, who scored a brace in the last league match.

Ulsan

The Ulsan Tigers are known for their solid defense, having conceded only two goals in the current Champions League campaign, which is one of the best records in the competition. However, the South Korean club has struggled significantly in away matches, failing to win on the road since May. In their last Champions League outing, the team secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Sanfrecce Hiroshima.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Vissel Kobe (4-1-2-3): Maekawa; Sakai, Yamakawa, Thuler, Hatsuse; Ogihara; Saito, Ideguchi; Muto, Osako, Miyashiro.
  • Ulsan (4-2-3-1): Jo Hyeon-woo; Seol Young-woo, Kim Young-gwon, Hwang Seok-ho, Lee Myung-jae; Ko Seung-beom, Lee Chung-yong; Um Won-sang, Lee Dong-gyeong, Kelvin; Joo Min-kyu.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite their recent setbacks, Vissel Kobe appears to be the favorite in this home fixture. Their strong home record and high-scoring attack should be key factors. Ulsan is defensively solid, but their poor away form could prove to be an insurmountable obstacle.

  • Main Prediction: Vissel Kobe to Win. The Japanese club will be eager to bounce back in front of their home fans and end their winless streak. The home advantage and Ulsan's away struggles favor the hosts.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Vissel Kobe scores a lot in the Champions League but has also been conceding lately. Given the attacking prowess of the home side and both teams' desire to top the group, a high-scoring game can be expected.

Borneo vs Dewa United: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the 11th round of the Indonesian Liga 1, where the undisputed league leaders, Borneo FC, host Dewa United at their stadium in Balikpapan. The home side will aim to extend their impressive unbeaten run, while the visitors hope to end their streak of poor results in the league and improve their standings.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK) Stadium: Batakan Stadium, Balikpapan Competition: Indonesia Super League

Borneo vs Dewa United: Match Preview

Borneo comes into this match in phenomenal form, being the only team in the league yet to drop a single point. The team has secured 8 wins in 8 matches and confidently leads the league table with 24 points. Dewa United, in contrast, has shown inconsistent results in the championship and sits in 13th place with 10 points from 9 games. However, their recent success in the AFC Challenge League, where they advanced to the quarterfinals, might boost their confidence. In their last six head-to-head meetings, Borneo has won four times, while Dewa United has been victorious twice. Notably, Borneo has always defeated Dewa at home.

Team Form and Analysis

Borneo

'Pesut Etam,' under the guidance of Fabio Lefundes, are the dominant force this season. The team demonstrates a perfect balance between attack and defense: having scored 17 goals, they have conceded only 4, which is the best record in the league. Their home form is impeccable, with a 100% win rate. The club comes into the match after a week-long break, giving them an advantage in physical freshness. In attack, Argentine Mariano Peralta stands out with 5 goals to his name.

Dewa United

The team, managed by Jan Olde Riekerink, is struggling in the league, having failed to win in their last three league matches. However, in the AFC Challenge League, the 'Banten Warriors' performed admirably, securing big wins and finishing top of their group. This success has undoubtedly lifted the team's morale. Nevertheless, a tight schedule and playing away from home might take a toll on the players' physical condition.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Borneo (4-2-3-1): Nadeo Argawinata; Caxambu, Christophe Nduwarugira, Komang Teguh, Fajar Faturrahman; Rivaldo Pakpahan, Kei Hirose; Mariano Peralta, Juan Villa, Maicon; Joel Vinicius.
  • Dewa United (4-2-3-1): Sonny Stevens; Rizdjar Nurviat, Wahyu Prasetyo, Nick Kuipers, Edo Febriansyah; Hugo Gomes, Alexis Messidoro; Stefano Lilipaly, Ricky Kambuaya, Egy Maulana Vikri; Privat Mbarga.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Borneo is the absolute favorite in this encounter. Their perfect form in the league, powerful performance at home, and advantage in freshness make their victory the most likely outcome. Dewa United may be on a high after their success in Asia, but facing the flawless Borneo machine away from home will be an extremely tough challenge.

  • Main Prediction: Borneo to Win with a (-1) Handicap. Considering their impressive statistics and solid defense, a comfortable victory for the hosts by at least one goal is expected.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Borneo has a potent attack, and Dewa United, despite their league struggles, has been scoring in recent matches. A clash between two motivated teams could be a high-scoring affair.

Johor Darul Ta'zim vs Shanghai Shenhua: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of an intriguing AFC Champions League Elite match, where the Malaysian champions, Johor Darul Ta'zim, host one of the leaders of the Chinese Super League, Shanghai Shenhua, at their Sultan Ibrahim Stadium. This encounter is of great importance for both teams in their quest to advance to the next stage of the tournament.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 12:15 UTC (15:15 MSK) Stadium: Sultan Ibrahim Stadium, Iskandar Puteri Competition: AFC Champions League Elite

Johor Darul Ta'zim vs Shanghai Shenhua: Match Preview

Johor Darul Ta'zim (JDT), known as the Southern Tigers, approach the match in magnificent form. The team is dominating their domestic league with 9 wins in 9 matches and has been impressively prolific. In their last Champions League fixture, JDT secured a crucial away victory against another Chinese club, Chengdu Rongcheng (2-0), marking their first win in the current campaign. Shanghai Shenhua are also in good form, being unbeaten in their last six matches. In the previous round of the Champions League, they comfortably defeated FC Seoul (2-0). The only prior meeting between the teams last season ended in a convincing 3-0 victory for JDT.

Team Form and Analysis

Johor Darul Ta'zim

The Malaysian giants are renowned for their powerful performances at home. This season, the team has not suffered a single defeat at their stadium, securing 9 wins and one draw in ten matches. JDT's attack looks formidable: in their last five official games, the team has scored 22 goals while conceding only one. However, the team has a significant personnel loss: key defender Feroz Baharudin is out for the rest of the season with an ACL injury.

Shanghai Shenhua

Shanghai Shenhua sits second in the Chinese Super League and has shown consistent results under Russian coach Leonid Slutsky. The team is unbeaten in their last six matches across all competitions. Brazilian forward André Luís stands out in the Chinese club's squad as their top scorer. Shanghai Shenhua will be looking to avenge last year's defeat and prove their mettle in the fight for group stage progression.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Johor Darul Ta'zim (4-3-3): Syihan Hazmi; Matthew Davies, Jordi Amat, Shane Lowry, La'Vere Corbin-Ong; Hong Wan, Afiq Fazail, Ignacio Méndez; Arif Aiman, Bergson, Fernando Forestieri.
  • Shanghai Shenhua (4-2-3-1): Bao Yaxiong; Manfa, Jiang Shenglong, Zhu Chenjie, Yang Zexiang; Wu Xi, Ibrahima Amadou; Xie Pengfei, João Carlos Teixeira, Yu Hanchao; André Luís.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Johor Darul Ta'zim are the favorites for this match. Their incredible form at home, combined with their high scoring rate, poses a serious challenge for any opponent. Shanghai Shenhua is a strong and organized team, but an away trip to Malaysia to face a motivated and in-form JDT will be a significant test for them.

  • Main Prediction: Johor Darul Ta'zim to Win. The home-field advantage, current form, and psychological edge from last year's victory should help the Southern Tigers to come out on top.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. JDT plays a hyper-offensive style of football, averaging over 4 goals per game in their recent matches. Considering the attacking potential of both teams, a high-scoring game can be expected.

Orenburg vs Krasnodar: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the first leg of the RPL Path quarter-finals of the FONBET Russian Cup, where Orenburg hosts one of the leaders of Russian football, Krasnodar, at their Gazovik Stadium. For the hosts, this is a chance to prove their ambitions in a cup clash against a formidable opponent, while the 'Bulls' intend to confirm their status as favorites.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 13:00 UTC (16:00 MSK) Stadium: Gazovik, Orenburg Competition: Russian Cup

Orenburg vs Krasnodar: Match Preview

Krasnodar comes into this match in excellent form, leading the RPL table and having won six consecutive matches in all competitions. The 'Bulls' comfortably finished first in their group in the previous cup stage. Orenburg, on the other hand, is fighting for survival in the Premier League, currently sitting in 14th place. In the last round, the team secured a crucial 3-1 victory over Sochi, breaking a string of poor results. The head-to-head history favors Krasnodar, with the 'Bulls' having won the last five encounters. In total, the teams have met 15 times, with Krasnodar winning 9 and Orenburg 2.

Team Form and Analysis

Orenburg

Ildar Akhmetzyanov's team is facing difficulties in the championship, but the victory over direct competitor Sochi should give the players confidence. In the Russian Cup, Orenburg finished second in a group with Zenit, Rubin, and Akhmat. At home, Orenburg traditionally plays boldly, but the team lacks stability, as evidenced by recent heavy defeats to Zenit (0-6) and Spartак (0-1). A personnel issue is the suspension of Revazov.

Krasnodar

Murad Musaev's team is playing like champions this season. Krasnodar is not only achieving results but also demonstrating a solid defense, having kept a clean sheet in six of their last seven matches. Last weekend, the 'Bulls' secured a comeback victory against Spartak (2-1), once again showing their character. However, Krasnodar has significant injury problems, with Jubal and Moses Cobnan set to miss the match.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Orenburg (4-2-3-1): Ovsyannikov; Mufi, Khotulev, Chichinadze, Vedernikov; Kvekveskiri, Bolotov; Thompson, Rybchinskiy, Oganesyan; Jesus.
  • Krasnodar (4-3-3): Agkatsev; González, Costa, Paltsev, Petrov; Chernikov, Lenini, Spertsyan; Sa, Perrin, Córdoba.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Krasnodar is the undisputed favorite in this matchup. Their current form, consistency, and the quality of their players far exceed Orenburg's capabilities. Despite the home-field advantage, the hosts will find it extremely difficult to stand up to the RPL leaders.

  • Main Prediction: Krasnodar to Win. The 'Bulls' are at the peak of their form and will try to decide the tie in the first leg, extending their winning streak in head-to-head matches.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Krasnodar has a potent attack, and Orenburg will not sit back and defend at home. An average of 3 goals have been scored in Orenburg's last 10 games.

Arkadag vs Al-Ahli Doha: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth round of the AFC Champions League 2 group stage, where the champion of Turkmenistan, FC Arkadag, hosts the Qatari club Al-Ahli from Doha. This match is of critical importance for both teams in their fight for qualification from Group B, where the standings are incredibly tight.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 13:35 UTC (16:35 MSK) Stadium: Arkadag Stadium, Arkadag Competition: AFC Champions League 2

Arkadag vs Al-Ahli Match Preview

Arkadag comes into this home fixture at the bottom of the group with two points, yet they are only three points behind the leader, highlighting the group's competitiveness. The previous encounter between these teams in Doha ended in a dramatic 2-2 draw, with the Turkmen club equalizing in the 91st minute. This away result has undoubtedly boosted Arkadag's confidence. Al-Ahli, with three points, is tied for second place and is also in dire need of a victory to improve their position. The champion of Turkmenistan is known for its invincible domestic form, boasting a long winning streak, and will aim to translate that success to the international stage.

Team Form and Analysis

Arkadag

Founded in 2023, the team is a dominant force in Turkmenistan, having won all domestic trophies. On the international stage, the debutants are still gaining experience: after a draw with Andijon (0-0) and a loss to Al-Khaldiya (0-2), the team made an impressive comeback against Al-Ahli (2-2). Arkadag is famous for its potent attack, as evidenced by their dominance in the national championship. Their home stadium is a true fortress, and the support of their fans will be a significant factor.

Al-Ahli (Doha)

The Qatari club, coached by Croatian Igor Bišćan, a UEFA Champions League winner with Liverpool, has yet to find consistency in the Asian tournament. The team has drawn all three of their matches. Al-Ahli's squad features the 2014 World Cup winner with Germany, Julian Draxler, which speaks to the club's high ambitions. Despite letting a win slip away in the home match, Al-Ahli demonstrated their ability to dominate and apply pressure, which they will try to replicate in the away game.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Arkadag (4-4-2): Charyyev; Annagulyyev, Saparov, Bashimov, Mammedov; Atayev, Gurbanov, Beknazarov, Annadurdyyev; Durdyyev, Tirkishov.
  • Al-Ahli (4-2-3-1): Abunada; Al-Naeimi, Mitrović, Yaseen, Al-Islam; Al-Saeed, Vlap; Draxler, Sekou, Al-Dokali; Al-Naimat.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite being newcomers, Arkadag poses a serious threat at home. Their incredible domestic record and the character they showed in Doha make them favorites for this match. Al-Ahli has experienced players, but their inconsistency and the away factor could work against them.

  • Main Prediction: Arkadag to Win. The Turkmen champions are highly motivated to secure their first-ever group stage victory in front of their home crowd. Given their strength at home, this result seems the most likely.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. The first meeting between the teams showed that both can and love to attack. Arkadag will aim to dominate at home, while Al-Ahli, with their selection of attacking players, is always dangerous. A high-scoring game is expected.

Dynamo Makhachkala vs CSKA Moskva: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the most intriguing matches of the FONBET Russian Cup Regions Path quarter-finals, where one of the First League leaders, Dynamo Makhachkala, hosts CSKA Moscow at their Anzhi-Arena. For the hosts, this is a historic chance to cause a major upset, while for the Army Men, it's a serious test on their way to the trophy.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 15:15 UTC (18:15 MSK) Stadium: Anzhi-Arena, Kaspiysk Competition: Russian Cup

Dynamo Makhachkala vs CSKA Moskva: Match Preview

Dynamo Makhachkala is having a magnificent season, confidently among the leaders of the First League and boasting an impressive unbeaten streak. On their way to the quarter-finals, the team overcame Sochi, Rotor, and Orenburg. CSKA, on the other hand, finished third in their group in the previous stage, losing to Krasnodar and Akhmat, which led them to the Regions Path. The Army Men have gained good momentum in the RPL, but the trip to Kaspiysk to face a motivated and resilient opponent promises to be a serious challenge. This will be the first official meeting between the clubs.

Team Form and Analysis

Dynamo Makhachkala

Khasanbi Bidzhiyev's team has turned the Anzhi-Arena into a real fortress, where they have been undefeated for a long time. Dynamo is known for its organized and solid defense, having conceded the fewest goals in the First League. In the last league round, Makhachkala secured another victory, beating Tyumen 1-0. The team's attack is led by forward Egas Cacintura.

CSKA Moskva

Under Marko Nikolić, the Army Men are playing pragmatic football and consistently picking up points in the RPL. However, the team's performance in the Cup was not at its best, which led them to the lower bracket. Given the difficult away match and upcoming league fixtures, the CSKA coaching staff may resort to squad rotation. Nevertheless, the depth of the squad and the class of players like Fedor Chalov and Abbosbek Fayzullaev allow the Army Men to remain favorites.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Dynamo Makhachkala (5-3-2): Volk; Alibekov, Shumakhov, Kovačević, Khramtsov, Sundukov; Glushkov, Yusupov, Abdullahi; Cacintura, Kozhaev.
  • CSKA Moskva (3-4-2-1): Torop; Diveev, Moisés, Agapov; Glebov, Zdjelar, Méndez, Gajić; Fayzullaev, Dávila; Chalov.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Although CSKA is the representative of the elite division and the favorite on paper, an easy ride is not expected for them. Dynamo, at home with the support of their fans, is capable of putting up a fight against any opponent, as their cup run proves. A lot will depend on how seriously the Army Men approach the match and what lineup Marko Nikolić will field.

  • Main Prediction: CSKA to Qualify. Despite all the difficulties, the class and experience of the Army Men should prevail. The victory might be secured in extra time or a penalty shootout.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Dynamo has the best defense in their league and will try to play as tightly as possible. CSKA is not always prolific away from home, so a high-scoring affair is not expected.

Zenit vs Dinamo Moskva: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the main event of the FONBET Russian Cup RPL Path quarter-finals, where the reigning cup holders, Zenit St. Petersburg, host Dinamo Moskva at the Gazprom Arena. This is a clash between the two capitals and two of Russia's top clubs, promising to be a true highlight of the cup evening.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 17:30 UTC (20:30 MSK) Stadium: Gazprom Arena, Saint Petersburg Competition: Russian Cup

Zenit vs Dinamo Moskva: Match Preview

Both teams approach this cup derby in good form, positioned among the leaders of the Russian Premier League. Zenit comfortably won their Russian Cup group, securing victories in all six matches. Dinamo, on the other hand, finished second in their quartet, ceding the top spot to Spartak. The recent history of encounters favors the team from St. Petersburg: Zenit has not lost to Dinamo at home since 2014. The last match between the teams in the RPL in St. Petersburg ended in a convincing 3-1 victory for the hosts.

Team Form and Analysis

Zenit

Sergei Semak's team has hit its stride and looks very powerful, especially at the Gazprom Arena. In their last 16 home matches, Zenit has recorded 15 victories. In the previous round of the Cup, they thrashed Akhmat 4-1. The attacking line of St. Petersburg, featuring Mateo Cassierra and Claudinho, is one of the strongest in the country. Given the importance of the match, Semak is likely to field his strongest lineup to secure a comfortable advantage before the return leg.

Dinamo Moskva

The 'White-Blues' under Marcel Lička play a vibrant and attacking style of football. The team scores a lot, but their defense remains a weak point, as demonstrated in the last match against Zenit. In the last RPL round, Dinamo secured a 2-0 victory over Krylia Sovetov. The leaders of the Moscow attack are Konstantin Tyukavin and Fedor Smolov. The trip to St. Petersburg will be a major test of Dinamo's ambitions in the fight for the trophy.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Zenit (4-3-3): Adamov; Karavaev, Eraković, Nino, Santos; Barrios, Wendel, Claudinho; Mostovoy, Cassierra, Pedro.
  • Dinamo Moskva (4-3-3): Leshchuk; Skopintsev, Fernández, Balbuena, Dasa; Laxalt, Chávez, Fomin; Ngamaleu, Tyukavin, Carrascal.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Zenit is the favorite in this encounter, especially in a home match. Their incredible form at the Gazprom Arena, a balanced squad, and a successful history against Dinamo make their chances of winning very high. Dinamo is capable of putting up a fight with their attack, but their defensive problems could be fatal for them.

  • Main Prediction: Zenit to Win. The St. Petersburg side plays almost flawlessly at home and will aim to build a comfortable lead before the return leg in Moscow.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches between these teams are often high-scoring. Dinamo's attacking style and the power of Zenit's offense suggest an abundance of goal-scoring opportunities. 5 of the last 6 head-to-head meetings have seen more than 2 goals scored.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Champions League league phase, where the tournament debutants, Paphos FC of Cyprus, host Spain's Villarreal at the Alphamega Stadium. For the hosts, this is another opportunity to make a statement on the European stage, while the 'Yellow Submarine' is in desperate need of their first victory.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 17:45 UTC (20:45 MSK) Stadium: Alphamega Stadium, Limassol Competition: UEFA Champions League

Paphos vs Villarreal: Match Preview

Paphos has been one of the surprises of the tournament's opening stages, managing to collect two points from three matches thanks to draws against Olympiacos (0-0) and Kairat (0-0). The team's only defeat came at the hands of Bayern Munich (1-5). Villarreal, in contrast, has had a disastrous start to their European campaign, earning just one point and sitting in 31st place in the overall standings. However, in La Liga, Marcelino's team has turned a corner: three consecutive wins, including a 4-0 thrashing of Rayo Vallecano, have lifted them to third place. This will be the first-ever official meeting between the clubs.

Team Form and Analysis

Paphos

Under the guidance of Juan Carlos Carcedo, the team displays an organized style of football with an emphasis on defense, which has allowed them to keep two clean sheets in the Champions League. Paphos is also performing confidently in the Cypriot league. However, the team faces personnel issues ahead of this crucial match: attacking midfielder João Correia is suspended, and defender Pedrão is injured. The 38-year-old veteran David Luiz is expected to start in central defense.

Villarreal

The 'Yellow Submarine' is in excellent form and travels to Cyprus as the clear favorite with immense motivation. Marcelino's side needs a win to rectify their dire situation in the Champions League. Despite their good form, Villarreal also has squad absences. Defenders Willy Kambwala and Logan Costa, as well as midfielder Pau Cabanes, are unavailable due to injuries.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Paphos (4-2-3-1): Michael; Felipe, Luckassen, Luiz, Pileas; Rodrigues, Sunjic; Quina, Dragomir, Orsic; Bassouamina.
  • Villarreal (4-4-2): Junior; Mourino, Foyth, Veiga, Pedraza; Comesana, Partey, Gueye, Buchanan; Pepe, Mikautadze.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Villarreal is the undisputed favorite in this encounter. The difference in class, experience, and the current form of the Spanish team should be the deciding factors. Paphos will try to fight for points through disciplined defense, but containing Villarreal's in-form attack will be an extremely difficult task.

  • Main Prediction: Villarreal to Win with a (-1) Handicap. The Spanish club needs a convincing victory to improve their league standing and goal difference, and they will go all out to achieve it.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Villarreal has been scoring freely in recent matches, and Paphos, playing at home with the support of their fans, might take risks and play more openly, leading to a high-scoring game.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Champions League league phase, where the champions of Azerbaijan, Qarabağ FK, host London's Chelsea at the Tofiq Bahramov Republican Stadium in Baku. For the hosts, this is a historic opportunity to play against a European giant at home, and for the visitors, it's an important step towards the knockout stages.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 17:45 UTC (20:45 MSK) Stadium: Tofiq Bahramov Republican Stadium, Baku Competition: UEFA Champions League

Qarabağ vs Chelsea: Match Preview

Both teams come into this head-to-head clash with six points from their first three matches. Qarabağ has been one of the surprises of the tournament's opening stages, securing sensational victories over Benfica (3-2) and Copenhagen (2-0), before falling to Athletic Bilbao (1-3) in the last round. Chelsea, under Enzo Maresca, bounced back from an away defeat to Bayern Munich (1-3) with two home wins against Benfica (1-0) and Ajax (5-1). The history of encounters between these teams is heavily in favor of the English side: in the 2017/18 season, the Blues thrashed Qarabağ twice with a combined score of 10-0 (6-0 and 4-0).

Team Form and Analysis

Qarabağ

Gurban Gurbanov's team is the undisputed leader of Azerbaijani football and is known for its resilience at home. The 'Horsemen' have already proven they can cause upsets in this Champions League campaign. Their only defeat in the last 11 matches came against Athletic Bilbao. The team approaches the match without any major injury concerns, which is an added advantage.

Chelsea

The Londoners are in fine form, having won six of their last seven matches, including a derby victory over Tottenham last weekend. Baku is a happy hunting ground for Chelsea, as it was here they won the 2019 Europa League final, thrashing Arsenal. However, Enzo Maresca has some personnel issues: Cole Palmer and Benoît Badiashile will miss the match due to injury, along with long-term absentees Levi Colwill and Dário Essugo. It is expected that the manager may rotate his squad ahead of important Premier League fixtures.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Chelsea are the clear favorites for this encounter, despite the long flight and potential squad rotation. The gulf in class between the teams is enormous, as confirmed by their previous meetings. Qarabağ can cause problems at home, but it is unlikely they will be able to take points from a motivated English club.

  • Main Prediction: Chelsea to Win with a (-1.5) Handicap. The Blues will want to secure their qualification for the next stage as soon as possible and are likely to claim a comfortable victory.

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth round of the AFC Champions League Two group stage, where Saudi Arabia's Al Nassr hosts India's FC Goa at Al-Awwal Park in Riyadh. The home side will be looking to secure their spot in the knockout stages with games to spare, while for the visitors, this is the last chance to keep their hopes of advancing in the tournament alive.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 18:15 UTC (21:15 MSK) Stadium: Al-Awwal Park, Riyadh Competition: AFC Champions League 2

Al Nassr vs Goa: Match Preview

Al Nassr comes into this match as the undisputed leader of Group D, with a maximum point haul after three rounds. The Saudi Arabian team is in excellent form, having won 11 of their last 12 matches across all competitions. A recent loss in the King's Cup to Al-Ittihad was their only setback lately. FC Goa, on the other hand, is the group's underdog, having lost all three of their previous matches. Despite this, the Indian club has been performing well domestically, reaching the semi-finals of the Super Cup. The previous encounter between these teams in India ended in a 2-1 victory for Al Nassr, with the Saudi club playing without several of its stars.

Team Form and Analysis

Al Nassr

Under the guidance of Jorge Jesus, the team boasts one of the strongest squads in Asia, featuring stars like Cristiano Ronaldo, João Félix, and Kingsley Coman. In the AFC Champions League 2, Al Nassr has been prolific, scoring 9 goals in three games. The team is particularly formidable at home, averaging nearly 3 goals per game. It is expected that the coach may rest some key players for this match, but the squad's depth allows Al Nassr to remain the clear favorite.

Goa

For FC Goa, participating in this tournament is primarily a valuable experience. Manolo Marquez's team has shown themselves to be a competitive unit, managing to score against Al Nassr in the first meeting – a historic achievement for Indian football in this competition. Despite three losses in the group, the 'Gaurs' approach the match in high spirits following their success in the Super Cup. However, playing away against such a formidable opponent will be a major test, especially considering the team has lost three of their last four away games and has struggled offensively on the road.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Al Nassr is the absolute favorite for this clash. The difference in class between the teams is enormous, and even if the Saudi club fields a rotated squad, they should win comfortably. FC Goa will try to play an organized defense, but containing the host's powerful attack for the entire match will be nearly impossible.

  • Main Prediction: Al Nassr to Win with a (-2.5) Handicap.

Welcome to the live broadcast of an intriguing fourth-round match in the UEFA Champions League league phase, where France's Olympique Marseille hosts Italy's Atalanta at the Stade Vélodrome. Both teams have had a sluggish start to the tournament, and this match is of immense importance in their fight for a spot in the playoff zone.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Stade Vélodrome, Marseille Competition: UEFA Champions League

Olympique Marseille vs Atalanta: Match Preview

Marseille comes into this match with only three points from three games, sitting in 18th place in the overall standings. Roberto De Zerbi's side lost 2-1 away to Sporting CP in the last round. Atalanta has one more point and is in 17th place. However, Ivan Jurić's team is in a prolonged crisis, winless in their last six matches in all competitions, and lost 1-0 to Udinese in Serie A last weekend. These teams met in the 2023/24 Europa League semi-finals, where Atalanta advanced with a 4-1 aggregate victory, though the match at the Vélodrome ended in a 1-1 draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Olympique Marseille

Olympique is showing contrasting results in the league and in Europe. While they are second in Ligue 1 and competing for the title, their Champions League campaign has been challenging. However, Marseille is traditionally strong at home: the team is unbeaten in 14 of their last 15 matches at the Vélodrome, winning 12. In their last home Champions League match, they thrashed Ajax 4-0. Marseille has significant personnel problems: Geoffrey Kondogbia, Amine Gouiri, and others are injured, while Emerson is suspended.

Atalanta

The Bergamaschi are experiencing a major slump. The team has transformed from an attacking and vibrant side into a pragmatic and not very prolific one. Atalanta drew five of their last six games before the loss to Udinese. In the Champions League, the team failed to score against Slavia Prague (0-0) in the last round. Furthermore, Atalanta has a historically poor record in France, having never won in four matches.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Marseille (4-2-3-1): Rulli; Murillo, Pavard, Aguerd, Garcia; Vermeeren, Højbjerg; Greenwood, O'Riley, Paixão; Aubameyang.
  • Atalanta (3-4-3): Carnesecchi; Kossounou, Hien, Djimsiti; Bellanova, Éderson, Pašalić, Zappacosta; De Ketelaere, Krstović, Lookman.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite their head-to-head history, Marseille appears to be the favorite for this match. The home-field advantage, where Olympique is nearly unbeatable, and Atalanta's deep crisis should be decisive. De Zerbi's team will be eager to bounce back from the defeat in Lisbon and secure a crucial victory.

  • Main Prediction: Marseille to Win. Given Atalanta's dreadful form and Marseille's powerful performances at the Vélodrome, a home win looks the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. Marseille scores a lot in the Champions League (6 goals in 3 games) but also concedes regularly. Atalanta, despite their problems, has quality players in attack and could find their chance.

Welcome to the live broadcast of a historic fourth-round match in the UEFA Champions League league phase, where Inter Milan hosts the champions of Kazakhstan, Kairat Almaty, at the legendary Stadio Giuseppe Meazza (San Siro). For the Italian giants, this is an opportunity to solidify their position in the tournament, while for the visitors, it is an invaluable experience playing in one of the world's greatest arenas.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Stadio Giuseppe Meazza (San Siro), Milan Competition: UEFA Champions League

Internazionale vs Kairat: Match Preview

Inter comes into this match as one of the group leaders and the clear favorite. Simone Inzaghi's side has collected six points from three matches, losing only away to Atlético Madrid (0-1) but comfortably defeating Union SG (4-0) and Club Brugge (2-1). The Nerazzurri are also in the hunt for the Scudetto in Serie A. Kairat, making their debut in the Champions League proper, are still searching for their first win, having only managed a single point in a sensational 0-0 draw with Cypriot side Paphos. In their other matches, the Kazakh club lost to Olympiacos (0-2) and Sporting CP (0-3). This will be the first-ever official meeting between Inter and Kairat.

Team Form and Analysis

Internazionale

The Italian giants are traditionally dominant on their home turf. The team is known for its solid defense, built around a three-center-back formation, and an efficient attack led by captain Lautaro Martínez. Given the gulf in class, it is expected that Simone Inzaghi may rotate his squad, giving some fringe players a chance to impress ahead of important domestic fixtures. However, even with a rotated lineup, Inter will be in complete control of the game.

Kairat

For the team from Almaty, this match is the main event of their season. Kairat, under the guidance of Aleksandr Kerzhakov, will rely on an extremely tight and organized defense, hoping for rare counter-attacking opportunities. The maximum objective for the Kazakh club is to put up a respectable performance against one of Europe's strongest clubs and try to avoid a heavy defeat. Any goal scored at the San Siro would be a historic achievement for Kairat.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Internazionale (3-5-2): Sommer; Pavard, de Vrij, Bastoni; Darmian, Barella, Çalhanoğlu, Mkhitaryan, Dimarco; Thuram, Martínez.
  • Kairat (5-4-1): Ustimenko; Seydakhmet, Arad, Vasin, Keiler, Tkachenko; João Paulo, Krachkovskiy, Sadybekov, Zaria; Shvyrev.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Inter is the absolute and undisputed favorite in this contest. The difference in class, experience, and player quality between the teams is colossal. The only question is how many goals the Italian club will score. Kairat will try to work a miracle, but their chances are virtually non-existent.

  • Main Prediction: Inter to Win with a (-3) Handicap. The Nerazzurri will likely dismantle the debutant's defense at home and secure a comprehensive victory.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Inter to Win to Nil. Kairat has yet to score in an away Champions League match, and it is highly unlikely they will manage to do so at the San Siro against one of Europe's best defenses.

Club Brugge vs Barcelona: Match Preview

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Champions League league phase, where Ajax hosts Galatasaray at the Johan Cruyff Arena in Amsterdam. For the Dutch giants, who have had a disastrous start to the tournament, this is the last chance to stay in contention, while the Istanbul club will be aiming for a third consecutive victory.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Johan Cruyff Arena, Amsterdam Competition: UEFA Champions League

Ajax vs Galatasaray: Match Preview

Ajax comes into this match in dreadful form in the Champions League. Johnny Heitinga's side has lost all three of their opening matches with a combined score of 1-11, falling to Inter Milan (0-2), Marseille (0-4), and Chelsea (1-5). This has left the Amsterdam club at the bottom of the overall tournament standings. The team's domestic form has also been underwhelming. Galatasaray, in contrast, bounced back from an opening 5-1 thrashing by Eintracht Frankfurt to secure two home wins against Liverpool (1-0) and Bodø/Glimt (3-1). The Turkish champions are on an eight-match unbeaten run in all competitions. The head-to-head history between these teams is sparse, with only one official meeting in last season's Europa League, which ended in a 2-1 victory for Ajax.

Team Form and Analysis

Ajax

The Amsterdam club is experiencing one of its deepest crises in recent memory. The team has won just one of its last six matches across all competitions. Problems are evident in all areas: Ajax currently has the worst attack and the worst defense in the Champions League. Adding to the on-field crisis are significant personnel issues: Kenneth Taylor will miss the match due to suspension, while Steven Berghuis, Kasper Dolberg, and Branco van den Boomen are all injured.

Galatasaray

Okan Buruk's team is riding a wave of confidence. The 'Lions' are performing strongly both domestically and on the European stage. Galatasaray's attack looks very potent, led by Nigerian forward Victor Osimhen, who has scored three goals in the Champions League. The Turkish club will be looking to capitalize on Ajax's problems and secure their third consecutive win in the competition, a feat they haven't achieved since the 2012/13 season. The only major absence for them is the injured İlkay Gündoğan.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Galatasaray (4-2-3-1): Çakır; Jakobs, Bardakcı, Sánchez, Szalai; Yılmaz, Lemina, Torreira, Sané; Osimhen, Akgün.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Despite the home-field advantage, Galatasaray appears to be the favorite in this encounter. Their current form, confident attacking play, and the opponent's deep crisis make the Turkish club's chances of winning very high. It will be extremely difficult for Ajax to offer any resistance to Okan Buruk's motivated and in-form team.

  • Main Prediction: Galatasaray to Win. Given Ajax's terrible form and their personnel issues, the in-form Galatasaray should be able to take all three points in Amsterdam.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Ajax is conceding an average of almost 4 goals per game in the Champions League, while Galatasaray possesses a powerful attack. The match promises to be a high-scoring affair.

Welcome to the live broadcast of a thrilling fourth-round encounter in the UEFA Champions League, where Lisbon's Benfica hosts the German champions, Bayer Leverkusen, at their legendary Estádio da Luz. For the Portuguese club, this is a decisive match in their fight to keep their playoff hopes alive, while the 'Werkself' aim to bounce back from a crushing defeat in the last round.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Estádio da Luz, Lisbon Competition: UEFA Champions League

Benfica vs Bayer Leverkusen: Match Preview

Benfica has had a very poor start to their Champions League campaign, securing only one point from three matches and sitting in 34th place in the overall standings. The Eagles lost to Chelsea (0-1) and Qarabağ (2-3), managing only a draw against Shakhtar Donetsk (2-2). In the Portuguese league, Roger Schmidt's team is performing much better. Bayer Leverkusen, under Xabi Alonso, on the other hand, is playing powerful football, but the team has not always been consistent in Europe. In the last round, the Germans suffered a crushing 7-2 defeat to PSG, which was a significant blow. The head-to-head history between these teams is quite rich: in six matches, Benfica has won twice, Bayer three times, and one game ended in a draw.

Team Form and Analysis

Benfica

The Estádio da Luz is a true fortress for Benfica, where the team is traditionally strong. The Eagles will be highly motivated to redeem themselves in front of their fans for their poor start to the tournament. The team's attacking prowess is led by the veteran Ángel Di María and the Brazilian David Neres. However, Lisbon has serious defensive issues, having conceded at least two goals in their last three Champions League matches. Furthermore, key left-back Juan Bernat will miss the match due to injury.

Bayer Leverkusen

After the humiliating defeat in Paris, Xabi Alonso's team will be eager to prove it was just a fluke. The 'Werkself' possess one of the most potent attacks in Europe, featuring stars like Victor Boniface and Florian Wirtz. In the Bundesliga, Bayer continues to fight for the top spots. However, an away trip to Lisbon is never easy, and the team will face fierce resistance from a motivated opponent. Bayer also has injury concerns: striker Patrik Schick and defender Edmond Tapsoba are sidelined.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Benfica (4-2-3-1): Trubin; Bah, Silva, Otamendi, Morato; Neves, Kökçü; Di María, Silva, Neres; Arthur.
  • Bayer Leverkusen (3-4-2-1): Hradecky; Kossounou, Tah, Hincapié; Frimpong, Xhaka, Palacios, Grimaldo; Hofmann, Wirtz; Boniface.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

The match promises to be extremely tense and unpredictable. Benfica, at home, is capable of beating any opponent, and they desperately need a win. Bayer is stronger on paper and will be looking to bounce back from their failure in Paris.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. Given Benfica's extreme motivation at home and the class of Bayer, who will want to avoid a second consecutive UCL defeat, a draw seems the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. Benfica has defensive problems but is strong in attack at home. Bayer has one of the best attacks in Europe. An exchange of goals in such a game is almost inevitable.

Manchester City vs Borussia Dortmund: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the key matches of the fourth round of the UEFA Champions League, where England's Manchester City hosts Borussia Dortmund at the Etihad Stadium. This clash between two European giants promises to be rich in tactical battles and exciting moments, especially with former City player Jadon Sancho returning to Manchester.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: Etihad Stadium, Manchester Competition: UEFA Champions League

Manchester City vs Borussia Dortmund: Match Preview

Manchester City comes into the match as one of the tournament leaders, with a maximum point haul after three rounds. Pep Guardiola's side is in phenomenal form, especially at home, where they are unbeaten in 33 Champions League matches - the second-longest streak in the tournament's history. Borussia Dortmund, in contrast, has had a poor start in Europe, earning only one point and sitting in 29th place in the overall standings. In the last Champions League round, Dortmund lost at home to Juventus (1-3). The head-to-head history is entirely in City's favor, with the English side having won the last four meetings.

Team Form and Analysis

Manchester City

The Citizens are in peak form. Last weekend, they thrashed Bournemouth 6-1 in the Premier League. Guardiola's team is the highest-scoring side in this season's Champions League, with 11 goals in three matches. The attacking duo of Erling Haaland and Phil Foden strikes fear into any defense. Despite the injury to Kevin De Bruyne, City has enough squad depth to dominate the match.

Borussia Dortmund

Nuri Şahin's team is going through a difficult period. After the defeat to Juventus, Dortmund failed to beat Hoffenheim in the Bundesliga (1-1). Dortmund has lost 8 of their last 10 away matches in the Champions League. In addition to defensive issues, they have significant personnel problems: key players Julian Brandt, Donyell Malen, and first-choice goalkeeper Gregor Kobel will miss the match due to injury.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Manchester City (4-2-3-1): Ederson; Walker, Akanji, Dias, Gvardiol; Rodri, Kovačić; Silva, Álvarez, Foden; Haaland.
  • Borussia Dortmund (4-3-3): Meyer; Ryerson, Süle, Schlotterbeck, Rothe; Sabitzer, Can, Nmecha; Bynoe-Gittens, Füllkrug, Sancho.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Manchester City is the overwhelming favorite for this encounter. Their current form, especially at home, and Dortmund's injury crisis make a victory for the English club almost a foregone conclusion. It will be extremely difficult for Dortmund to offer any resistance to Pep Guardiola's machine.

  • Main Prediction: Manchester City to Win with a (-2) Handicap. The Citizens regularly crush their opponents at the Etihad, and a weakened Dortmund is unlikely to escape this fate.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 3.5 Goals. City is the tournament's top-scoring team, and Dortmund has serious defensive problems. The match promises to be very high-scoring.

Newcastle United vs Athletic Club: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the fourth matchday of the UEFA Champions League league phase, where England's Newcastle United hosts Athletic Club from Bilbao at their legendary St. James' Park. For the Magpies, this is a chance to secure a third consecutive victory in the tournament, while the Basques will be looking to pick up important points on the road.

Kick-off: November 5, 2025, 20:00 UTC (23:00 MSK) Stadium: St. James' Park, Newcastle upon Tyne Competition: UEFA Champions League

Newcastle vs Athletic Club: Match Preview

The teams meet in an official match for the first time in 30 years since their 1994 UEFA Cup clash, where Athletic advanced on the away goals rule. Newcastle approaches the match in high spirits in the Champions League, having secured two consecutive big wins against Union SG (4-0) and Benfica (3-0) after an opening defeat to Barcelona. These results have lifted Eddie Howe's side to 8th place in the overall standings. Athletic, on the other hand, started with two losses but claimed a comeback victory over Qarabağ (3-1) in the last round, moving them up to 21st. However, both teams suffered defeats in their domestic leagues last weekend.

Team Form and Analysis

Newcastle United

St. James' Park has been a true fortress for the Magpies this season. Eddie Howe's team has won their last four home matches, scoring nine goals and conceding only one. In European competitions, Newcastle is unbeaten in 29 of their last 33 home games. However, the team has significant personnel issues: Tino Livramento and Yoane Wissa will miss the match due to injury, while the participation of Kieran Trippier and Bruno Guimarães is in doubt due to illness.

Athletic Club

Ernesto Valverde's side is struggling in away matches, having failed to win in their last five games on the road (four losses). Historically, Athletic also has a poor record in England, with only one win in ten matches. The situation is exacerbated by an injury crisis: the Basques will be without key attacking players, the Williams brothers, Iñaki and Nico, as well as Oihan Sancet and key defender Yeray Álvarez.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Newcastle (4-3-3): Pope; Trippier, Schär, Thiaw, Burn; Miley, Tonali, Joelinton; Elanga, Woltemade, Barnes.
  • Athletic Club (4-2-3-1): Simón; Gorosabel, Paredes, Laporte, Boiro; Ruiz de Galarreta, Rego; Berenguer, Jauregizar, Navarro; Guruzeta.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Newcastle are the clear favorites for this encounter. Their strong performance at home, current form in the Champions League, and Athletic's colossal injury problems make a victory for the English club the most likely outcome. The Basques, weakened by the absence of their leaders, are unlikely to be able to offer much resistance to a motivated Magpies side.

  • Main Prediction: Newcastle to Win with a (-1) Handicap. Newcastle plays with great confidence at home and will aim for a comprehensive victory to improve their position in the table.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Four of Newcastle's last five matches have seen three or more goals, and given Athletic's defensive issues, this trend is likely to continue.
